paragraphs: Rabbi Idi, Rav Sheshet’s sarsit—that is, his attendant. Rashi, Hamafkid 42: the household supervisor. He stated a law heard from Rav Sheshet without attributing it to him; Rav Sheshet took offense because of “Let me dwell in Your tent forever,” etc., Pesulei Hammukdashin 31b.
